Ethan (Finance): Heads up - VendorOps sent an annual invoice to ClientY for Private deployment setup: INV-AC-410 for $120,000. Our signed contract S-5110 only authorizes monthly billing ($10k/mo). Did anyone approve an annual prepay?
Priya (RevOps): I searched CLM. Contract S-5110 = monthly platform fee $10,000 + Standard support $1,200/mo. No amendment or signed quote for annual prepay.
Liam (CS): Customer mentioned wanting annual pricing in an email but I don't see an executed amendment. I flagged procurement convo earlier.
VendorOps (Vendor): We issued INV-AC-410 because procurement submitted PO PO-2025-778 asking for annual billing. We can void and reissue if instructed.
billing-bot: vendor-ingest created invoice INV-AC-410 (job vi-2025-04-02).
Ethan (Finance): Do not accept revenue recognition on annual invoice without signed amendment. Julie, can billing ask vendor to void and reissue monthly? We want to avoid deferred/reversal stress.
Julie (Billing): Opening ticket BILL-701. Recommended path: ask vendor to void INV-AC-410 and reissue 12 monthly invoices matching contract. Will add rev hold flag.
Priya (RevOps): Agreed. Also add audit note linking PO, procurement contact, and the unsigned quote Q-990. We'll request procurement withdraw PO or provide executed amendment.
Liam (CS): I'll message the customer procurement and ask them to withdraw PO-2025-778. If they want annual, tell them we need signed amendment and a new quote.
VendorOps (Vendor): Confirmed - we'll hold cash application and can void invoice on receipt of written instruction from Redwood billing.
Ethan (Finance): Approved. Julie, include impact note for month-close and deferred revenue if the invoice had been posted. Priya, please prepare rev note.
Julie (Billing): Will do. Target to have vendor void confirmation in ticket by EOD. Will post credit/void proof in BILL-701.
Priya (RevOps): Adding rev hold and audit entries now.
Liam (CS): Posted procurement contact and thread in BILL-701. I'll follow-up externally.
Ethan (Finance): Thanks everyone. Follow-up items: vendor void, rev hold, procurement withdrawal or amendment, reissue monthly invoices.
